== Diagrams

.Imaging chain interconnection
[mermaid]
....
---
config:
  fontFamily: "Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif"
  theme: base
  themeCSS: ".edgeLabel rect { opacity: 1 !important; } .cluster-label .nodeLabel { text-align: center; }"
  themeVariables:
    fontFamily: "Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif"
    fontSize: "14px"
    primaryColor: "#FFFFFF"
    secondaryColor: "#FFFFFF"
    tertiaryColor: "#FFFFFF"
    background: "#FFFFFF"
    primaryBorderColor: "#181818"
    primaryTextColor: "#000000"
    lineColor: "#181818"
    textColor: "#000000"
    noteBkgColor: "#FEFFDD"
    noteBorderColor: "#181818"
    noteTextColor: "#000000"
    clusterBkg: "#FFFFFF"
    clusterBorder: "#181818"
    edgeLabelBackground: "#FFFFFF"
---
%% Observatory::interconnectView — interconnection rendering (render asInterconnectionDiagram)
flowchart LR
  subgraph n0 ["`*«part»* **imagingChain**`"]
    direction LR
    subgraph n1 ["`*«part»* **camera**`"]
      direction LR
      n1.0["^output"]
    end
    subgraph n2 ["`*«part»* **recorder**`"]
      direction LR
      n2.0["^input"]
    end
  end
  n1.0 === n2.0
  linkStyle 0 stroke-width:3px
....

....
---
config:
  fontFamily: "Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif"

  themeVariables:

    noteBorderColor: "#181818"

    stateBkg: "#FFFFFF"
    stateBorder: "#181818"

    compositeBackground: "#FFFFFF"

    compositeTitleBackground: "#FFFFFF"

---
%% state rendering (the diagram states kind "state")
stateDiagram-v2
  direction LR
  state "«state» operatingStates" as n0 {
    state "«state»<br>idle<br>initial" as n1
    state "«state»<br>observing" as n2
    [*] --> n1
  }
  n1 --> n2
  n2 --> n1
....
